Description: Paid $2,400 cash for a 12-month store insurance policy that starts October 1.
Bought $8,500 of merchandise from Wasatch Lumber Supply on account.
Sold merchandise for $1,250 cash. The merchandise cost $780.
Received a $600 cash deposit from a customer for a custom order to be delivered in November.
Paid Wasatch Lumber Supply the $8,500 owed, within the discount period, taking a 2% discount. Ridgeline uses a perpetual inventory system.
Sold merchandise on account to a contractor for $3,200. The merchandise cost $2,050.
Paid $3,000 cash for October store rent.
Paid $4,800 cash for wages earned October 1-15.
Bought a $12,000 forklift, paying $2,000 cash and signing a note payable for the rest.
Collected the $3,200 the contractor owed from October 10.
Received the $410 October electric bill, to be paid in November.
Recorded October's share of the insurance policy bought on October 1.
Accrued $5,100 of wages earned October 16-31, to be paid November 1.
Recorded $250 of depreciation on store equipment for October.
Accrued one month of interest on the $10,000 note payable at 6% a year.
Declared and paid a $1,000 cash dividend.
